notes: Every image slot the app currently renders. Keys map to files at `path`; components reference them by key via <Plate plate="key" />. Nothing is required for the app to run: every slot draws a bordered placeholder at the correct ratio until its file exists.

style.direction: Nineteenth century field survey plate. Hand drawn naturalist engraving.
style.medium: Ink line on paper. Cross hatching and stipple for tone, never soft shading or airbrush.
style.colour: Monochrome. Ink line only. No fills, no wash, no gradient, no colour of any kind.
style.line: Hairline weight, consistent across the set, matching a 1px UI rule optically.
style.background: Transparent unless the asset says otherwise. The app's paper shows through.
style.composition: Generous margins. Subject sits in the frame, never bleeding off unless stated.
style.reference: Ordnance Survey memoir illustrations, Victorian natural history plates, architectural survey drawings.
avoid: borders or frames drawn into the artwork
people, unless the asset explicitly asks for a figure
style.palette_note: If the tool insists on colour, use ink #16181A on paper #F4F2EC and nothing else.

assets.slot: app icon, replaces the CSS leaf in app/icon.tsx
assets.subject: The app mark
assets.prompt: A single leaf, drawn as one confident silhouette with a visible midrib and two or three side veins. Simple enough to read at 32 pixels. Centred, generous margin, no stem foliage.

assets.subject: The app mark, safe zone
assets.prompt: The same leaf mark, scaled so the whole subject sits inside the centre 60 percent of the frame. Everything outside that is flat paper, because Android crops it to a circle or a squircle.

assets.subject: Distant ridge line
assets.prompt: A far ridge of low Irish hills across the full width. Outline and the lightest possible hatching only. No foreground detail, no trees, no buildings. Reads as distance.
assets.constraints: MUST tile horizontally: the right edge has to butt against the left edge with no visible seam. The image scrolls in a loop. No sky, no ground fill, transparent above and below the ridge.

assets.subject: Near fields and hedgerows
assets.prompt: Nearer ground across the full width: field boundaries, a hedgerow, a gate, one or two hawthorns. More detail and heavier hatching than hills-far, since it travels faster and reads as closer.
assets.constraints: MUST tile horizontally with no seam. Transparent above and below. Keep the skyline low, roughly the bottom third, so it sits under the far ridge.

assets.subject: The decision
assets.prompt: A figure standing at a field gate where a boreen forks, one hand on the top bar, deciding which way to go. Seen from behind or three quarters, face not visible. Irish countryside, stone wall, hawthorn.

assets.subject: An independent shopfront
assets.prompt: A small village cafe or pub front on an Irish street. Painted timber facade, hand painted fascia rendered as blank ink line with no readable lettering, a bicycle against the wall, one window box.

assets.subject: A high cross
assets.prompt: An early medieval Irish high cross standing in a field, weathered, with interlace carving suggested rather than drawn in full. Long grass at the base, a leaning graveyard wall behind.

assets.subject: A ringfort from ground level
assets.prompt: A circular earthen ringfort bank seen from the field beside it, low and grassed over, with the outer ditch visible and a gap where cattle cross. Deliberately unspectacular: the point is that it looks like an ordinary bump until you know.

assets.subject: Mist lifting off fields
assets.prompt: Low morning mist clearing off a patchwork of small irregular Irish fields with stone wall boundaries, seen from a rise. Hatching thins toward the cleared side to suggest the fog lifting.
